story_thesis: Lower spending explains the entire improvement in Reality Labs’ quarterly operating loss. Meta’s full-year outlook implies a more expensive December quarter.
duplicate_checks: First evening slot; no same-date legacy Mag7 article, ledger entry or open PR. Morning batch BA, UPS, NKE. Existing Meta coverage addresses advertising and AI capex or general segment economics.
evidence_table: 10-Q segment results and IR table: operating loss 4432 to 4129, revenue 470 to 443; expense saving 330 less revenue decline 27 = improvement 303 ($m).
10-Q segment note: employee compensation 2594 to 1970; other costs rose 294 by subtraction. MD&A identifies Quest and glasses offsets in both periods.
IR nine-month loss $12.775bn; annual 10-Q outlook $18–19bn less reported loss implies $5.225–6.225bn.
